$comment: The hidden-line isometric wireframe drawings, from the brand's illustration skill (mireye-wireframe-illustrations: scripts/engine.js, fill.js, kit.js and scenes/, vendored unchanged in brand/illustrate/wire). style is the skill's fixed series style (wire.js STYLE and mksvg.js): true isometric at azimuth 45, S 2.6 px per world unit (a scene may export its own S), weights 1.0, 0.7 and 0.5 px, x-ray 0.45 px, tones for a dark ground (mixes of Earth #2A2119 toward #F4EFE6) and for bone. pad is the skill's Figma pad (4). Scene labels and uses are the skill's own table.

datacenter.label: Data center
datacenter.use: A data center campus: shell with parapet, facade seams, roof equipment, yards, fences, parking. The reference scene.

datacenter-post.label: Data center, post scale
datacenter-post.use: The same campus redrawn for a 1080 by 1350 post at S 1.67, thinned rather than scaled.

substation.label: Grid interconnect
substation.use: A substation yard with transformers and a transmission tower.

solar.label: Renewable energy siting
solar.use: A solar farm on three graded terraces, with inverter skids and an access track.

warehouse.label: Commercial lending
warehouse.use: A logistics warehouse with loading docks.

residential.label: Residential land
residential.use: Parcels and lots with houses, poles and wires.

landsection.label: Land section
landsection.use: A single soil block with strata, ruler and parcel.

oneapi.label: One API hub
oneapi.use: A central hall with eight agent units on pads, wired by ground trunking.

apicore.label: One API core
apicore.use: A core block and die on a board, with eight agent cubes joined by cables (MCP tools).
